auth.title: Welcome
auth.subtitleSignIn: Sign in to sync your logs across devices.
auth.subtitleSignUp: Create an account to get started.
auth.previewNotice: Sign in is unavailable in this preview build.
auth.legal: By continuing, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
auth.callbackFailed: That link didn't work. Please try signing in again.
auth.callbackExpired: This link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one to continue.
auth.errPasswordWeak: Use at least {{passwordMin}} characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number, and a symbol.
auth.errPasswordLeaked: This password has appeared in a data breach, so it is not safe to use. Please choose a different one.
auth.errAlreadyRegistered: An account with this email already exists.
auth.errNotConfirmed: Please verify your email before signing in.
auth.errUnavailable: Sign in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
auth.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a link to set a new password is on its way. The link expires in one hour.
auth.resetSubtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
auth.changeDoneBody: Your new password is active. Any other devices signed in to this account have been signed out.
auth.otherDevicesNotice: For your security, other devices signed in to this account will be signed out.
auth.managedBySocial: You sign in with {{provider}}, so there is no password to change here.
auth.errPasswordUnchanged: Your new password must be different from your current one.
auth.errNoPassword: This account signs in with Apple or Google, so it has no password.
auth.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.biometricPrompt: Confirm it is you to sign in.
auth.biometricEnablePrompt: Confirm it is you to turn on {{method}}.
auth.biometricToggleBody: Use {{method}} to sign back in without typing your password.
auth.biometricEnableFailed: {{method}} could not be set up on this device. Please try again.
auth.biometricSignOutNotice: When you sign out, {{method}} will sign you back in on this device. Turn this off to sign out completely.

biometricErr.unenrolled: {{method}} is not set up on this device yet. Add it in your device settings, then try again.
biometricErr.locked_out: {{method}} is locked after too many attempts. Unlock your device with its passcode, then try again.
biometricErr.rejected: That saved sign-in has expired. Please sign in with your password once, then you can turn {{method}} back on.
biometricErr.unknown: {{method}} sign in did not work. Please use your password instead.
